prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A fisheye lens view as if seen through a peephole, capturing two striking female characters standing close together outside a door. On the left, a gothic girl with long black hair, pale gray skin, and exaggeratedly large, pitch-black eyes grins widely, revealing sharp teeth. She wears a black dress, a large cross necklace, and holds a kitchen knife upright in one hand. On the right, a cheerful anime-style maid with short, pastel pink hair, big sparkling purple eyes, and a frilly black-and-white maid outfit beams with excitement, also holding a kitchen knife. Both characters are posed playfully, leaning in toward the viewer, their expressions contrasting—one eerie and mischievous, the other bubbly and cute. The background is softly blurred, suggesting an outdoor suburban setting. The color palette is a mix of muted neutrals and vibrant pastels, with high contrast and soft, even lighting. At the bottom, glittery pink text reads “Hai senpai~” with a sparkling heart, adding a playful, meme-like quality. The overall style blends dark gothic and kawaii anime aesthetics, with a cinematic, slightly unsettling yet humorous mood.
